aviation_incidents.headline: 西捷航空737 MAX 8拖行時翼梢小翼撞上餐車 機上無人且無人受傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 西捷航空一架737 MAX 8在多倫多皮爾遜機場拖往過夜停機位時，翼梢小翼撞上停放的餐車；機上無乘客或機組員，無人受傷，飛機損傷程度尚未確認。加拿大運輸安全委員會正蒐集資訊，但不打算派調查人員。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: WestJet 737 MAX 8 strikes parked catering truck while being towed; no injuries
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A WestJet 737 MAX 8 struck a parked catering truck with its winglet while being towed to an overnight parking pad at Toronto Pearson. No passengers or crew were on board, no one was injured, and the damage has not been officially confirmed. Canada’s Transportation Safety Board is gathering information but does not plan to deploy investigators.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 美方齒輪箱通報後台灣陸軍停飛阿帕契 改派眼鏡蛇與奇奧瓦執行戰備
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部長顧立雄表示，國防部收到美方技術通報後，陸軍AH-64E阿帕契直升機已停飛。停飛屬預防措施，目前沒有具體事故通報；檢查完成前，將由AH-1W超級眼鏡蛇與OH-58D奇奧瓦直升機執行戰備任務。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan grounds Army Apaches after U.S. gearbox alert and assigns Super Cobras and Kiowas
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Defense Minister Kuo Li-hsiung said the Ministry of National Defense received a U.S. technical notice and the Army’s AH-64E Apaches are grounded. The precautionary measure follows a potential gearbox concern; no specific accident has been reported. AH-1W Super Cobras and OH-58D Kiowas will take on readiness missions until inspections are complete.
entities: AH-1W超級眼鏡蛇攻擊直升機

taiwan_aviation.headline: 巴基斯坦一度拒絕台灣航空公司使用領空後恢復通行 行政院表達遺憾
taiwan_aviation.summary: 巴基斯坦一度以一中政策為由拒絕台灣航空公司使用其領空，之後恢復通行。行政院於10月29日表達高度遺憾；交通部與民航局表示將與業者保持聯繫、提供協助並掌握航路動態。巴方已核准華航與長榮航空於10月28日至隔年3月27日使用其領空。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Pakistan restores airspace access to Taiwan carriers after brief refusal; Taiwan’s Executive Yuan regrets move
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Pakistan briefly refused Taiwanese airlines access to its airspace, citing a one-China policy, then restored access. Taiwan’s Executive Yuan expressed strong regret on October 29. The transport ministry and civil aviation authority said they would stay in contact with carriers, provide assistance and monitor routes. Pakistan approved China Airlines and EVA Air to use its airspace from October 28 to March 27 next year.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 曼谷蘇凡納布機場跑道受損 華航CI840改至隔日飛高雄
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航表示，曼谷飛高雄的CI840受蘇凡納布機場跑道受損影響，考量高雄機場宵禁後改至隔日出發；跑道疑似在航班準備起飛時出現大面積凹陷，航機檢查後確認安全，旅客獲安排餐飲、住宿及接駁。另華航CI160因機務訊號異常延遲數小時，航空公司依程序檢查。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines moves CI840 to next day after runway damage in Bangkok
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines moved CI840 from Bangkok to Kaohsiung to the following day after runway damage at Suvarnabhumi Airport affected aircraft operations; the airline also took Kaohsiung’s curfew into account. A large depression was suspected as the flight prepared for takeoff. The aircraft was inspected and found safe, and passengers were provided with meals, accommodation and transport. Separately, CI160 was delayed by several hours after an abnormal maintenance signal prompted checks.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 國籍航空 — 曼谷機場跑道受損 華航飛高雄遇宵禁改隔日出發

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空推出雙向哩程累積及兌換服務
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空擴大合作，推出雙向哩程累積與兌換服務。雙方會員可用累積哩程兌換對方營運航班的酬賓機票，搭乘符合資格的航班也可累積哩程，並可申請補登；旅客可經阿提哈德位於阿布達比的樞紐前往全球逾120個目的地。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux and Etihad launch two-way mileage earning and redemption
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines and Etihad Airways have expanded their partnership to include two-way mileage earning and redemption. Members can use miles for award tickets on flights operated by the other airline, earn miles on eligible flights and claim missing mileage credits. The partnership also offers connections through Etihad’s Abu Dhabi hub to more than 120 destinations worldwide.

international_aviation.headline: Discover Airlines退役最後一架A330-200 D-AXGE完成末班商業航班
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空旗下Discover Airlines於2026年10月28日確認退役最後一架A330-200，註冊號D-AXGE。該機執飛末班商業航班4Y51，從費城飛往法蘭克福，於當地時間06:36降落；它也曾執行該航空公司2021年7月的首班載客航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Discover Airlines retires final A330-200 after its last commercial flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa’s Discover Airlines confirmed on October 28, 2026, that it had retired its last Airbus A330-200, registration D-AXGE. The aircraft operated its final commercial flight, 4Y51 from Philadelphia to Frankfurt, landing at 06:36 local time. It had also operated Discover Airlines’ first passenger flight in July 2021.

international_aviation.headline: FAA資助JetZero 530萬美元 為Jet1驗證機裝設引擎氣流量測設備
international_aviation.summary: JetZero於2026年10月28日宣布獲美國FAA「持續低能源、低排放與低噪音」第四階段計畫530萬美元資助，將為正在建造的全尺寸翼身融合驗證機Jet1安裝引擎與進氣道量測儀器。設備將記錄多種飛行及地面作業狀況下的氣流數據；Jet1預計於2027年第四季首飛。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA awards JetZero $5.3 million for engine airflow instrumentation on Jet1
international_aviation.summary_en: JetZero announced on October 28, 2026, that it had been selected for $5.3 million in funding under Phase IV of the FAA’s CLEEN program. The funding will support engine and nacelle instrumentation on Jet1, the company’s full-scale blended-wing-body demonstrator under construction. The equipment will record airflow during flight and crosswind ground operations; the aircraft is scheduled to make its first flight in the fourth quarter of 2027.

sources.name: AeroTime — FAA backs flight tests of JetZero’s top-mounted engines

international_aviation.headline: airBaltic計畫裁減約100名機師與200名空服員 10月31日起通知員工
international_aviation.summary: airBaltic計畫裁減約100名機師及約200名空服員，數字尚未定案，員工自10月31日起將陸續得知去留；這是公司10月5日公布的500至700人整體人力調整中的機組人員安排，並非額外裁員。工會要求暫停評估並先共同檢視遴選標準。
international_aviation.headline_en: airBaltic plans to cut around 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew, with notices from October 31
international_aviation.summary_en: airBaltic plans to cut around 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew, though the figures are not final. Employees will begin receiving individual notices about whether they will keep their jobs from October 31. The crew cuts are part of the wider 500-to-700-person workforce adjustment announced on October 5, not additional reductions. The union has called for the assessment to pause until selection criteria are jointly reviewed.

international_aviation.headline: GE核准NYCO渦輪油用於GEnx-1B 法航完成近7000小時飛行評估
international_aviation.summary: GE航太核准NYCO的TURBONYCOIL 600渦輪油用於波音787採用的GEnx-1B發動機。法航以多具發動機進行逾36個月、近7000飛行小時的評估；拆解檢查確認潤滑組件獲有效磨損防護，積碳沉積量低，相關結果促成核准。
international_aviation.headline_en: GE qualifies NYCO turbine oil for GEnx-1B after Air France trials
international_aviation.summary_en: GE Aerospace has qualified NYCO’s TURBONYCOIL 600 turbine oil for GEnx-1B engines used on Boeing 787 aircraft. Air France evaluated the oil across multiple engines for more than 36 months and nearly 7,000 flight hours. Engine teardowns and inspections confirmed effective wear protection for lubricated components and low levels of coke deposition, leading to the qualification.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空預計12月開航首條A350-1000航線 導入新Allegris客艙
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空規劃於12月啟用首條由A350-1000執飛的航線，導入全新Allegris客艙，並為三個亞洲目的地增加高階客艙運能。漢莎先前已選定東京作為旗下首架A350-1000商業首航目的地。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa plans December launch of first A350-1000 route with new Allegris cabins
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa plans to launch its first Airbus A350-1000 route in December, introducing its new Allegris cabins and adding premium-cabin capacity for three Asian destinations. The airline had previously selected Tokyo as the destination for the first commercial flight of its first A350-1000.
